name: Old Fashioned

lines.note: granulated; muddled with the water and bitters

steps: Dissolve the sugar with the bitters and a little water in the glass.
Add the whiskey and ice and stir until chilled.
Express an orange peel over the drink and garnish.

name: Benton's bacon fat-washed bourbon

lines.note: PUNCH excerpt did not show volume; Difford's uses 70 cl bottle

ratio_note: PUNCH: 1 1/2 oz bacon fat to bourbon (bourbon volume not captured). Difford's: at least 60 ml warm rendered bacon fat into a 70 cl bottle of bourbon (fat from about 24 grilled smoky bacon slices).
process: Melt the bacon fat gently over low heat.
Stir the liquid fat into the bourbon in a nonreactive container and let it infuse.
Chill until the fat sets solid, lift it off.
notes: Infusion time and chilling time not captured in excerpts; left null.
